blocks.text: Canada and the EU “see the world with the same eyes,” according to European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen. And the feeling appears mutual. “Our commitment to the rule of law, and our unyielding defense of human dignity, individual freedom and democracy share the same deep roots, the same unwavering dedication,” Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said.
